2610.06052.title: Local2Mesh: Spatially Localized Contour-to-Mesh for Left Ventricular Reconstruction from Sparse 2D Cardiac MRI
2610.06052.paper_summary: Three-dimensional (3D) left ventricular (LV) reconstruction from sparse cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging remains challenging due to inter-slice misalignment and insufficient local spatial information between slices. Global aggregation of contour features may obscure local contour-to-surface relationships. We propose Local2Mesh, a spatially localized contour-to-mesh framework that deforms a template mesh to reconstruct 3D LV geometry from sparse 2D contours without 3D mesh annotations. The framework introduces geometry-aware alignment to correct inter-slice misalignment and a plane-aware Local Router that routes contour features to template vertices using vertex-to-plane distances. Local and global contour features then jointly guide graph-based template deformation for 3D LV reconstruction. Experiments on two public datasets, M\&Ms-2 and ACDC, demonstrate superior geometric reconstruction and functional estimation over existing methods. Zero-shot transfer from M\&Ms-2 to ACDC demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Reconstructed meshes also improve disease classification over sparse contours, supporting their utility for downstream cardiac analysis. These results demonstrate that combining geometry-aware alignment with local contour-to-vertex modeling improves LV reconstruction from sparse 2D contours and supports downstream cardiac analysis. The code is available at https://github.com/hwu918945-alt/loca2mesh.
2610.06052.paper_summary_zh: 三維 (3D) 左心室 (LV) 從稀疏心臟磁共振 (CMR) 成像重建仍然具有挑戰性，因為切片之間存在錯位以及切片之間的局部空間信息不足。輪廓特徵的全局聚合可能會掩蓋局部輪廓與表面之間的關係。我們提出了 Local2Mesh，一個空間局部的輪廓到網格框架，它通過變形模板網格來從稀疏的 2D 輪廓重建 3D LV 幾何形狀，而無需 3D 網格標註。該框架引入了幾何感知對齊，以修正切片間的錯位，並使用頂點到平面的距離來路由輪廓特徵到模板頂點的平面感知本地路由器。然後，局部和全局輪廓特徵共同指導基於圖的模板變形以進行 3D LV 重建。在兩個公共數據集 M\&Ms-2 和 ACDC 上的實驗顯示，與現有方法相比，幾何重建和功能估計優越。從 M\&Ms-2 到 ACDC 的零樣本轉移顯示出強大的跨數據集泛化能力。重建的網格在疾病分類上也優於稀疏輪廓，支持其在下游心臟分析中的實用性。這些結果表明，將幾何感知對齊與局部輪廓到頂點建模相結合，改善了從稀疏 2D 輪廓重建 LV 並支持下游心臟分析。代碼可在 https://github.com/hwu918945-alt/loca2mesh 獲得。
